Reviewed the TaskReviewThreads public route -> person authority -> module -> SQLite transaction -> derived view path. Metadata lists exclude artifact text, selected item reads refuse over 1048576 UTF-8 bytes/code units, output listing calls its owner once, and mutation projection resolves only the affected artifact. Structured answers and numeric summaries map losslessly; capture revision is its clean commit SHA. Request/event parsers, history-based admission, keyed replies/failures, retained block quotes and shared projections match contracts round 2. SQLite/store and real composed-route tests cover revocation, cross-Project/cross-incarnation refusals, caps, counts, Sent follow-ups and late replies/failures. No delivery, capture bytes, UI, native or release proof is claimed.
